entity.touhou_little_maid.maid.tip.en: Tame a maid with a cake and you are able to assist them with their tasks you choose. Look in Memorizable Gensokyo to learn more about it.

entity.touhou_little_maid.fairy.tip.en: Flies and shoots danmaku at you. Drops power points when killed.
entity.touhou_little_maid.fairy.tip.zh: 一边飞行，一边朝你发射弹幕。杀死后会掉落 P 点。

entity.touhou_little_maid.broom.tip.en: Requires a maid mounted on a broom in order to fly across the sky. Be advised some flying hostile mobs will still reach you such as Maid Fairies or Phantoms.
entity.touhou_little_maid.broom.tip.zh: 需要女仆也在上面时才能飞行。请注意，一些飞行的敌对生物仍然能接近你，例如女仆妖精或幻翼。

item.touhou_little_maid.power_point.tip.en: Power Points are found as loot, throw it to receive power points.
item.touhou_little_maid.power_point.tip.zh: P 点可以在战利品箱子里找到，丢出去来吸取 P 点。

item.touhou_little_maid.broom.tip.en: Requires a maid mounted on a broom in order to fly across the sky. Be advised some flying hostile mobs will still reach you such as Maid Fairies or Phantoms.
item.touhou_little_maid.broom.tip.zh: 需要女仆也在上面时才能飞行。请注意，一些飞行的敌对生物仍然能接近你，例如女仆妖精或幻翼。

item.touhou_little_maid.maid_backpack_sm.en: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 12.
item.touhou_little_maid.maid_backpack_sm.zh: 将女仆的背包拓展到 12 格。

item.touhou_little_maid.maid_backpack_mi.en: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 24.
item.touhou_little_maid.maid_backpack_mi.zh: 将女仆的背包拓展到 24 格。

item.touhou_little_maid.maid_backpack_bi.en: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 36.
item.touhou_little_maid.maid_backpack_bi.zh: 将女仆的背包拓展到 36 格。

item.touhou_little_maid.explosion_protec.en: Gives maid resistance to explosion damage.
item.touhou_little_maid.explosion_protec.zh: 让女仆能够抵御爆炸伤害。

item.touhou_little_maid.fall_protect_bau.en: Gives maid resistance to fall damage.
item.touhou_little_maid.fall_protect_bau.zh: 让女仆能够抵御摔落伤害。

item.touhou_little_maid.drown_protect_ba.en: Gives maid resistance to drown damage.
item.touhou_little_maid.drown_protect_ba.zh: 让女仆能够抵御溺水伤害。

item.touhou_little_maid.fire_protect_bau.en: Gives maid resistance to burning damage.
item.touhou_little_maid.fire_protect_bau.zh: 让女仆能够抵御火焰伤害。

item.touhou_little_maid.projectile_prote.zh: 让女仆能够抵御弹射物伤害。

item.touhou_little_maid.magic_protect_ba.zh: 让女仆能够抵药水伤害。

item.touhou_little_maid.mute_bauble.tip.en: Silence your maid if you're not a fan of their frequent talking.
item.touhou_little_maid.mute_bauble.tip.zh: 如果你不喜欢女仆经常说话，它能让你的女仆保持沉默

item.touhou_little_maid.nimble_fabric.ti.en: Gives maid the ability to dodge incoming projectiles by teleporting.
item.touhou_little_maid.nimble_fabric.ti.zh: 使女仆能够通过传送来躲避来袭的弹射物。

item.touhou_little_maid.crafting_table_b.en: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 18. Makes your maid a portable Crafting Table.
item.touhou_little_maid.crafting_table_b.zh: 将女仆的背包拓展到 18 格，同时提供一个便携式的合成台。

item.touhou_little_maid.furnace_backpack.en: Expands your maid's inventory slots up to 18. Makes your maid a portable Furnace.
item.touhou_little_maid.furnace_backpack.zh: 将女仆的背包拓展到 18 格，同时提供一个便携式的熔炉。

item.touhou_little_maid.hakurei_gohei.ti.en: A gohei used for creating an altar after you constructed it. Maids holding this gohei can shoot danmaku at hostile monsters.
item.touhou_little_maid.hakurei_gohei.ti.zh: 用于创建祭坛所用的工具。手持御币的女仆可以向敌对的生物发射弹幕。

item.touhou_little_maid.sanae_gohei.tip.en: A gohei used for creating an altar after you constructed it. Maids holding this gohei can shoot danmaku at hostile monsters.
item.touhou_little_maid.sanae_gohei.tip.zh: 用于创建祭坛所用的工具。手持御币的女仆可以向敌对的生物发射弹幕。

item.touhou_little_maid.film.tip.en: Your maid is deceased. to revive them, Place this in the altar along with a Gold Ingot, Iron Ingot, Lapis Lazuli, Coal, and Redstone on each pillar, or place it in the Shrine
item.touhou_little_maid.film.tip.zh: 你的女仆已经逝去了。要使她复活，请将其与金锭、铁锭、青金石、煤和红石一起放置在祭坛的每根柱子上，或将其放置在神龛中来复活

item.touhou_little_maid.wireless_io.tip.en: Gap is configurable to send items from chest to maid, or vice versa.
item.touhou_little_maid.wireless_io.tip.zh: 隙间可以把物品从箱子传送到女仆，反之亦然。

item.touhou_little_maid.picnic_basket.ti.en: Up to four maids will enjoy a picnic when they are idle. Be sure to load this basket with food. This increases favorability with your maids.
item.touhou_little_maid.picnic_basket.ti.zh: 四位女仆可以在休息日程时在这个野餐垫上享受野餐。一定要把食物装在野餐垫里，这会增加女仆的好感度。

block.touhou_little_maid.gomoku.tip.en: Challenge your maid to a Gomoku board game. Are you able to outsmart your maid in this board game?
block.touhou_little_maid.gomoku.tip.zh: 在五子棋游戏中挑战女仆，你能在这个游戏中智胜女仆吗？

block.touhou_little_maid.maid_bed.tip.en: Maids rest on this bed when it’s time to sleep. This increases favorability with your maid.
block.touhou_little_maid.maid_bed.tip.zh: 女仆在休息日程时会在这张床上睡觉。这会增加女仆的好感度。

block.touhou_little_maid.shrine.tip.en: Shrines are found in any loot chest at a rare rate. They can be used for resurrecting your maid, and will reduce your health to one.
block.touhou_little_maid.shrine.tip.zh: 神龛以罕见的几率出现在任何战利品箱中，这可以用来复活你的女仆，并将你的生命值降低到 1。

block.touhou_little_maid.computer.tip.en: This brings joy and increases favorability of your maid.
block.touhou_little_maid.computer.tip.zh: 这个方块能够给女仆带来欢乐，从而增加女仆的好感度。

block.touhou_little_maid.keyboard.tip.en: This brings joy and increases favorability of your maid.

block.touhou_little_maid.bookshelf.tip.en: This brings joy and increases favorability of your maid.
block.touhou_little_maid.bookshelf.tip.zh: 这个方块能够给女仆带来欢乐，从而增加女仆的好感度。

block.touhou_little_maid.scarecrow.tip.en: When placed on the ground, it prevents fairy maids from spawning in a square area.
block.touhou_little_maid.scarecrow.tip.zh: 放置在地面上，可以阻止妖精女仆在特定区域内生成。

block.touhou_little_maid.snack_cabinet.t.en: Storage container for items. Maids will eat block food placed on top and place block food from their inventory.
block.touhou_little_maid.snack_cabinet.t.zh: 可以存储物品。女仆会食用放在顶部的食物方块，还会把其物品栏中的食物方块放置到上方。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Item Magnet
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 物品磁铁

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: A bauble that can expand the pickup range. $(br2)After being equipped, the maid's pickup range of items, arrows, experience orb, and power points will be greatly increased.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 能够拓展拾取范围的饰品$(br2)装备上此饰品后，女仆拾取物品、箭、经验球、P点的范围将大大增加

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Base
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆基础

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: There are many basic functions that maids are able to perform, such as:$(li)By default, the maid will actively pick up items, arrows and experience orbs around her. The main GUI has a button to switch pick up mode;$(li)By default, the maid will always follow the player.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆拥有许许多多的基本行为，比如：$(li)默认情况下女仆会主动拾取周围的物品、箭、经验球和P点，女仆的主界面有按钮可以切换拾物模式；$(li)默认情况下，女仆总是跟随着玩家。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: $(li)Crouch right-clicking a maid with an empty hand can switch sitting mode. In sitting mode, maid doesn't do anything, including avoiding danger.$(li)When the maid rides on other entities, Crouch right-clicking with an empty hand can dismount them.$(li)The player can use a golden apple or potion on a maid by crouch right-click them while holding the item.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: $(li)Shift空手右击女仆能够切换待命模式。待命模式下的女仆什么也不会做，哪怕是规避风险。$(li)当女仆骑在其他实体上时，只需要Shift右击就可以把她们弄下来。$(li)玩家可以Shift右击女仆来对其使用金苹果或药水这样的物品。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: $(li)The experience picked up by the maid can be converted into an Bottle o' Enchanting if the player right-clicks the maid while holding a bottle.$(li)The maid can equip the skull and render the model of it.$(li)Right-click the maid with an empty name tag, and you can name them directly.$(li)When the maid holds the temptation item for animals, she is able to attract surrounding animals.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: $(li)当玩家手持玻璃瓶右击女仆时，女仆先前拾取的经验会转换成附魔之瓶。$(li)女仆能够装备并渲染头颅。$(li)用空白的命名牌右击女仆，能够直接命名。$(li)当女仆手持动物的吸引物时，能够吸引周围的动物。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: $(li)Use the saddle to right-click on the maid to carry the maid in yours arms.$(li)Creepers will avoid maids.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: $(li)使用鞍右击女仆将其抱在怀里。$(li)苦力怕会躲避女仆。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Bauble
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆饰品

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: This mod provides several baubles that can be triggered to protect maids under certain conditions. They need to be place in the bauble inventory.$(li)Ultramarine Orb Elixir: Can be used 6 times to avoid a maid's death.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 本模组添加了数个饰品，当女仆在特定情况下时会触发这些饰品来保护她。$(li)绀珠之药：能够避免6次女仆的死亡。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: $(li)Protect Bauble: When the maid receives the corresponding damage, the damage event is canceled.$(li)Nimble Fabric: When a maid equipped with this bauble is hit by a projectile, she will teleport like an enderman.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: $(li)保护饰品：当女仆受到对应伤害时，能够触发对应的保护。$(li)闪避布：当女仆被弹射物攻击时，行为将会和末影人一致。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Config
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆配置

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: This mod adds a lot of configuration for maids. You can set some attributes of the maids, and limit the maximum number of maids that can be tamed by the player.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 本模组为女仆添加了大量的配置文件，你可以设定女仆的某些属性，也可以设置玩家可驯服的最大女仆数量。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Skin
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆皮肤

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The maids' skin is completely customizable, you can easily change the maids' skin in game.$(br2)you can also add a third-party resource pack to further personalize the maid's skin.$(br2)Use the $(l:https://blockbench.net/)Blockbench$(/l) software to easily create your own maid skin resource pack, and place the package in the $(#f00)tlm_custom_pack$() folder under the game directory.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆的皮肤可以完全自定义，你也可以直接在游戏内切换女仆的皮肤。$(br2)你可以添加第三方的模型包来拓展女仆的皮肤。$(br2)只需要使用 $(l:https://blockbench.net/)Blockbench$(/l) 就能轻松创建你自己的模型包。模型包只需要放在游戏目录下的 $(#f00)tlm_custom_pack$() 文件夹中即可加载。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Click the button in the picture to open the maid skin GUI.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 点击图中按钮打开女仆皮肤切换界面。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Sound
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆声音

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: You can make custom sound resources packs to replace or expand the maid's sound effects.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 你可以制作自定义的声音资源包来替换或者拓展女仆的音效。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Click the button in the picture to open the maid sound GUI.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 点击图中按钮打开女仆声音切换界面。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Task
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆工作模式

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: When you open a maid's GUI, you can see a maid task button. Click it to switch the maid's task.$(br2)You can also click the schedule button to switch the maid's schedule so that it can work, rest or sleep in different time periods.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 当你打开女仆的GUI时，你可以找到切换工作模式的按钮，点击即可切换女仆的工作模式。$(br2)你还可以点击日程表按钮来切换女仆的日程，让其在不同的时间工作、休息或者睡觉

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Click the button in the lower right corner of the image to switch pictures
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 点击图中右下角按钮切换图片

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Mute Bauble
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 禁言饰品

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: After being equipped with this bauble, the maid will become very quiet.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 装备上此饰品后，女仆会变得十分安静。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Naming Eggs
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 命名彩蛋

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: A specially named maid can display a special model.$(br2)By default, a maid named with $(#ff0000)=>id$() can become the player skin model corresponding to that id.$(br2)The maid resource pack can also add custom model eggs, even SHA1 encrypted model eggs.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 特殊命名的女仆能够显示特殊模型，默认情况下，使用$(#ff0000)=>玩家ID$()命名的女仆能变成该ID对应的玩家皮肤模型。$(br2)女仆资源包也可以添加自定义的模型彩蛋，甚至是SHA1加密过的模型彩蛋。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid with the name $(#ff0000)=>Notch$().
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 命名为$(#ff0000)=>Notch$()的女仆模型。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Spawn Maid
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 生成女仆

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The way to get a maid is very special and needs to be done through a multi-block altar.$(br2)Since the recipe is likely to change in the future, please check the JEI altar label.$(br2)After the maid is successfully spawned in a multi-block altar, you will get a cake box wrapped with the maid, just right-click the cake box to open it.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 获取女仆的方式非常特殊，而且必须通过多方块祭坛才能获取。$(br2)因为合成表很有可能会在后续发生改变，所以请查询JEI的祭坛标签。$(br2)当在多方块祭坛中成功生成女仆后，你将会得到一个包装着女仆的蛋糕盒。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: You need to right-click three times to trigger different opening stages, and finally the cake box will disappear.$(br2)You will need a cake to tame the maid. the taming items can be changed in the configuration file.$(br2)The tamed maid is almost identical to a vanilla pet, and you can right-click to open her GUI.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 蛋糕盒右击即可打开，你需要右击三次触发不同的打开阶段，最后蛋糕盒会消失。$(br2)你需要一块蛋糕才能驯服女仆。驯服的物品可在配置文件中进行更改，此处不再累述。$(br2)驯服的女仆和原版宠物行为几乎一致，你可以右击打开她的GUI。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Substitute Jizo
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 替身地藏

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Substitute jizo is a creative mode item that can give invincible mode when right-clicked on a maid.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 替身地藏是一个创造模式物品，右击女仆可将其切换为无敌模式。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Home
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆Home

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: When the home mode button is clicked, the maid will record the current position and move within a range around it. (default range:12, can be modified in the config file)
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 当Home模式按钮被点击时，女仆会记录当前坐标，并在12格范围内移动。（可在配置文件中设置范围）

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Film
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 胶片

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The maid will drop a film after death, and the film can be used in an altar to resurrect the maid.$(br2)Film cannot be destroyed by fire or lava.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆会在死后掉落胶片，胶片可在祭坛中合成来复活女仆。$(br2)胶片不会被火焰或熔岩烧毁。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Gap
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 隙间

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: A bauble that can transport items. $(br2)You can right-click a chest with the gap to mark it, then open its GUI to make some settings, and finally place it in the maid's bauble inventory. $(br2)After this, the maid will take out/deposit the specified items "wirelessly" from the chest.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 一个能够传输物品的饰品。$(br2)你可以手持隙间右击箱子进行标记，而后打开它的GUI进行各种设置，最后将其放置在女仆的饰品栏中。$(br2)这之后，女仆就能从箱子中“无线”的取出/存入物品。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: You can use the compass to see the maid's home position
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 你可以使用指南针来看到女仆的Home坐标

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Snowball Fight
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 打雪仗

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: When the maid is on snow and in an idle task, the maid throws snowballs at the player or other maids
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 当女仆在雪地中，并且处于空闲模式时，女仆就会朝玩家或者其他女仆丢雪球。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Chat Bubbles
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 聊天气泡

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The maid occasionally displays several chat bubbles
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆会偶尔显示一些随机的聊天气泡

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Other Backpack
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 其他背包

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Some backpacks have other functions, such as the crafting table backpack, furnace backpack, and ender chest backpack
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 有些背包拥有其他功能，例如工作台背包、熔炉背包和末影箱背包

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Task Area
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆任务范围

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Kappa's compass is a tool that can set a maid's task area. You can use it to set the places where the maid works, rests or sleeps.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 河童的罗盘是一个能够划分女仆任务区域的工具，你可以通过它设定女仆工作、休息和睡觉的地点。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: First you need to right click on a block to set the positions, then right click on the maid to register the positions. $(br2)When the maid home mode is enabled, they will work within that area.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 首先你需要右击方块标记坐标，然后右击女仆即可写入坐标。$(br2)当女仆Home模式开启时，就会在上述划定的区域内工作。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Special Last Slot
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 特殊的最后一格

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The last slot in the top row of the maid's inventory will have a special display effect:$(li)Banner: The corresponding Banner is displayed on the maid's back$(li)Weapon: The corresponding weapon is displayed on the maid's back$(li)Plants: The corresponding plants are displayed above the maid's head
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆背包最上方一栏的最后一格会有特殊显示效果：$(li)旗帜：女仆背上显示对应旗帜$(li)武器：女仆背上显示对应武器$(li)植物：女仆头顶显示对应植物

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Banner display effect
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 旗帜的显示效果

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid's Meal
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆用餐

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The maid can eat while working or injured to increase her favorability or restore her health.$(br2)Please put food in their mainhand or offhand!
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆在工作或者受伤时可以进食，从而提升好感度或者恢复生命值。$(br2)请给她们的主手或副手放上食物！

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: When a maid is on an idle schedule, they will look for nearby picnic mats to eat, which will greatly increase their favorability.$(br2)Please serve them a delicious meal!
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆在空闲日程时，会寻找周围的野餐垫进食，这会大幅度提升她们的好感度。$(br2)请给她们放上美味的大餐吧！

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Servant Bell
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 仆人铃

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The servant bell can retrieve marked maids back one by one. If the maid is on an unloaded chunk, it can also prompt you where the maid is.$(br2)Hold this item and right click the maid to mark the maid!
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 仆人铃可以一对一的召唤回女仆，如果女仆在卸载区块上，它也能提示你女仆所处的位置。$(br2)手持此物品右击女仆即可进行绑定！

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Chisel & Statues
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 雕刻刀与雕像

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Right-click a clay block with a chisel to make statues of different sizes. Currently supports 1x1x1, 1x1x2, 2x2x4, 3x3x6 sizes.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 雕刻刀右击黏土可以做成不同尺寸大小的雕像，目前支持1x1x1、1x1x2、2x2x4、3x3x6大小尺寸。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The player needs to hold a photo of the maid in their offhand, with the mainhand holding the chisel, then right-click the lower left corner of the multi-block structure to engrave the maid in the photo.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 玩家副手持有女仆照片，主手持有雕刻刀，右击多方块结构的左下角，即可雕刻出照片中的女仆。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Garage Kit
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 手办

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The fire roasted 1x1 size statue can be converted into it.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 火烤1x1大小的雕像可以转换成它。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Shrine Lamp
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 神社庭灯

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The shrine lamp is a good decoration and has certain practical functions. Right click on the upper part of the shrine lamp to open the GUI. The player can store their power points here.$(br2)The shrine lamp is also a weapon.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 神社庭灯既是一个不错的装饰物，还具有一定的实用功能。右击神社庭灯的上部能够打开GUI，存储玩家的P点。$(br2)庭灯同样也是一个拥有攻击力的武器。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The player can also select an effect to bring to the surrounding range of maids at the cost of consuming power points.$(br2)The shrine lamp is also a good tool for automatically collecting power points. It can automatically collect power points within 6 blocks and store them.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 同时还能点击按钮选择相应的效果，这些效果会消耗P点来为周围范围的女仆带来对应增益效果。$(br2)神社庭灯还是一个自动收集P点的好工具，它能够自动收集其6格范围内的P点，并将其存储起来。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Trumpet
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 小号

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: A tool used to recall the maid, right-click to use. $(br2)$(4)$(l)Note: This item can only recall the maid on a loaded chunk. From a technical point of view, there is currently NO WAY to recall the maid on an unloaded chunk.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 一个用来召回女仆的工具，右击即可使用。$(br2)$(4)$(l)需要注意：这个道具只能召回已加载区块上的女仆。从技术角度说，目前还没有任！何！办！法！可以召回卸载区块上的女仆。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Custom Cushion
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 自定义坐垫

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The custom cushion is a purely decorative item, placed directly on the ground by right-clicking. Crouch left-click to destroy it, right-click to sit, crouch right-click to open the GUI to switch the cushion model.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 自定义坐垫是纯装饰向的物品，直接右击放置在地上，Shift左击能够打掉它。右击能够坐上，Shift右击可以打开切换坐垫样式的GUI。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The maid will automatically sit on a cushion when they are close enough. Crouch right-click the maid to make them stand up.$(br2)The cushion model can also be completely customized. You can choose from a list or you can quickly add a custom model through the model package.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 部分坐垫在女仆靠近时可以直接坐上，Shift右击女仆能够使其离开坐垫。$(br2)坐垫模型也可以完全自定义，也可通过资源包快捷添加自定义模型。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Command
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 指令

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: $(#f00)/tlm$(): This is the command provided by the mod$(br2)You can use it to set power, maid num, or reload the model package.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: $(#f00)/tlm$()：这是本模组提供的指令。$(br2)你可以通过它设置P点，女仆数量或者重载模型包。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Extinguisher
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 灭火器

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Required to be in the maid's mainhand when in extinguishing mode so allow her to put out fires. Can be in the maid's offhand in attack mode to deal extra damage to fire-immune mobs. Cannot be used by players.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 配合女仆灭火模式进行使用的物品，玩家无法使用。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid Bed
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆床

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The player can sleep, and naturally the maid can also sleep. During sleep schedule, the maid will to look for a surrounding bed to sleep in.$(br2)The sleeping maid will no longer be attacked by hostile creatures, and the maid's GUI also cannot be opened.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 玩家可以睡觉，自然而然女仆也可以睡觉。在睡觉的日程中，女仆会寻找周围的床睡觉。$(br2)睡着状态的女仆不会再被敌对性生物攻击，此时女仆的GUI也无法打开。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid sleeping in bed.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 睡在床上的女仆。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Power Point
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: P点

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Right-click to throw. Drops power points in experience form.$(br2)You can find power points in dungeon loot chests.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 右击丢出，能够掉落实体P点。$(br2)你可在地牢战利品箱内发现物品形态的P点。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Camera & Photo
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 相机与照片

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Carry a maid across dimensions or at a distance is a hassle. The camera was created to make that easier. $(br2)Just take a photo of your maid with the camera and turn her into a photo, then hold the photo and right click on a block to release her again.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 在跨维度或者远距离携带女仆是一个麻烦的事情，相机就是为此设计的。$(br2)只需要用相机对着自己的女仆拍摄就能将其变成照片，之后拿着照片对着方块右击又可以将其释放出来。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Model Switcher
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 模型切换器

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Used in creative mode, mainly designed for servers, can be used to display maid models
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 用于创造模式，主要面向服务器设计，可以用于展示女仆模型。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: First you need to right-click on a chosen maid with the item in your hand, then place it on the ground and open the GUI to set the list of models you want to show.$(br2)Then send a redstone signal on its left or right sides to switch the chosen maid's model.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 首先你需要手持此方块右击女仆。然后将其放置在地上，并右击打开GUI来设置你想展示的模型。$(br2)接下来在其左右两侧输入红石信号，即可切换此女仆的模型。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Chair Hitbox Displayer
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 坐垫显示器

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Crouch while holding this item to show the collision box of chairs.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 当手持并按下潜行键时，所有的坐垫都会显示碰撞箱。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Favorability Tool
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 好感度工具

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Right click on a maid to change the maid's favorability. Creative mode only.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 右击女仆改变女仆的好感度，仅限创造模式。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Fox Scroll
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 狐狸卷轴

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Use to find a maid or their tombstone.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 用来寻找女仆或者女仆墓碑。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Granite Inari Fox
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 麻石狐像

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Granite Inari Fox can prevent the spawning of maid fairies.$(br2)The prevent range is a square range, and the Y direction covers everything from the lowest point to the highest point!
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 麻石狐像可以阻止一定范围内女仆妖精的生成，不会影响其他生物的生成$(br2)限制范围是一个矩形范围，Y轴则是从最低点到最高点全部覆盖！

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Gomoku
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 五子棋

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: You can play gomoku with the maid, and winning will increase the maid's favorability.$(br2)After the player wins multiple times, the maid's gomoku skills will also increase.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 你可以和女仆一起玩五子棋，获胜能够增加女仆的好感度。$(br2)在玩家多次取得胜利后，女仆的五子棋技术也会上升。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Maid's Joy
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆娱乐

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Several recreational items that a maid will play on during her idle schedule, which can increase her favorability. Includes the Keyboard, Bookshelf, and Computer.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆能够在空闲日程玩耍，这能够增加她的好感度。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Shrine
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 神龛

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Has a low probability of appearing in loot chests. Can be used to revive a maid inside a film by consuming the player's health.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 有很低概率在战利品箱中发现。能够通过消耗玩家的生命值来复活胶片中的女仆。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Broom
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 扫帚

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The broom is a portable vehicle, but it requires the player and the maid to use it together.$(br2)Use the mouse to control the direction up or down, and WASD to control the movement forward, backward, left, and right.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 扫帚是一个便携的交通工具，但是需要你和女仆共同来使用。$(br2)通过鼠标来控制扫帚拉升或者下降，WASD控制前后左右移动。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Picnic Basket
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 野餐篮

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The picnic basket can store food. It also can be turned into a picnic mat by right-clicking a block to place it on the ground. Needs sufficient space to place. Up to four maids will enjoy sitting on a picnic when they are idle.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 野餐篮可以存储食物，右击放置在地上即可变成野餐垫。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Gohei And Danmaku
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 御币与弹幕

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The gohei is a normal melee weapon.$(br2)The maid holding a gohei will shoot danmaku while on the danmaku task.$(br2)Gohei can be attached with 2 vanilla enchantments: Multishot and Quick Charge, and can also be attached with 3 new enchantments added by this mod!
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 御币是一个普通的近战武器。$(br2)手持御币的女仆，在弹幕模式下会发射弹幕。$(br2)御币可以附加两个原版魔咒：多重射击和快速装填。还能附加三个本模组新增的魔咒！

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The gohei also is an important tool for building a multi-block altar.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 御币还是构建多方块祭坛的重要工具。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Multi-Block Altar
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 多方块祭坛

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The altar is the multi-block structure required for crafting in this mod.$(br2)The altar's recipes can be obtained through JEI. Crafting it also requires the player's $(l:overview/power_point)power point$().
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 祭坛是本模组用于合成所必需的多方块结构。$(br2)祭坛的合成表可以通过JEI获取，合成同时还需要玩家的$(l:overview/power_point)Power值$()。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Use the $(l:overview/gohei_and_danmaku)gohei$() to right click on the red wool located 4 blocks high in the center left, to build the altar.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 使用$(l:overview/gohei_and_danmaku)御币$()右击第四层中间偏左的红色羊毛正面，能够构建祭坛。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Multi-Block Altar
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 多方块祭坛

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: You can place items by right-clicking on the top of the six oak pillars of the altar. You can remove an item by right-clicking empty-handed.$(br2)When all required items are placed and the player has enough power points, the altar will start crafting.$(br2)The craft can be interrupted due to the lack of power, but the player can right click again to re-trigger the craft after getting more power.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 你可以右击六个橡木柱子的顶端来放置物品。通过空手Shift右击来移除物品。$(br2)当物品完全放置且玩家的Power值足够，祭坛就能触发合成。$(br2)因为缺少Power而导致的合成中断，在获取足够Power以后，再次右击可以重新触发合成。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Power Point
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: Power道具

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The power point is an important resource for this mod, which can be obtained by killing the $(l:overview/world_spawn#fairy)maid fairy$().$(br2)Can be used for $(l:overview/multiblocks_altar)altar$() crafting.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: Power道具是本模组重要的资源，通过杀死$(l:overview/world_spawn#fairy)女仆妖精$()来获取。$(br2)能够用于$(l:overview/multiblocks_altar)祭坛$()合成。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: When you hold a $(l:overview/gohei_and_danmaku)gohei$(), you can see your power point amount in the upper left corner of the game screen. $(br2)The maximum amount of power points is 5, and getting more will not increase the amount. $(br2)The maid can pick up power points, and will repair all items in her inventory that have the $(5)Mending$() enchantment.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 当你手持$(l:overview/gohei_and_danmaku)御币$()时，在游戏屏幕的左上角就能看到Power值。$(br2)Power值最大为5，超过此数值不再增长。$(br2)女仆能够拾取P点，并会修复其背包内所有拥有$(5)经验修补$()魔咒的物品。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Touhou Project
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 东方Project

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: The Touhou Project is a Japanese doujin game series by Sole Team Shanghai Alice member ZUN that specializes in Shoot 'em Ups.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 东方Project是日本同人社团上海爱丽丝幻乐团制作的一系列同人作品，系列以清版弹幕射击游戏为主。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Touhou Wiki
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: Touhou百科

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: World Spawn
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 世界生成

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: This mod adds one mob. $(br2)The loot dropped from of this mob are important crafting ingredients.$(br2)The chance of spawning hostile creatures in this mod can be modified in the configuration file. When set to 0, these monsters will be prohibited from spawning.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 这个模组添加了一种怪物。$(br2)怪物的掉落物是重要的合成材料。$(br2)本模组敌对性生物的生成几率均可在配置文件中进行修改，设置为0时可以禁止这些怪物生成。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Spawns in any biome at night. It will fly and shoot danmaku to attack players or iron golems.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 在任意群系的夜晚生成，会以飞行状态弹幕攻击玩家或铁傀儡。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: There is a chance that a maid will spawn in pillager outpost cages.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 女仆有概率在掠夺者前哨站的笼子里生成

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Make Custom Model
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 制作自定义模型

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Making a custom model pack is very simple. All you need is Blockbench, which is a free and open source software that is easy to use. $(br2)The custom model also supports Bedrock Edition animations, as well as a rich set of molang variables.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 制作一个自定义模型包非常简单，你只需要Blockbech。Blockbench是一个免费开源的软件，而且非常易于上手。$(br2)自定义模型也支持基岩版动画，并且提供了大量molang参数可用。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: I specially designed a plugin for making model packs with Blockbench, visit the link below to learn how to install the plugin.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 我特意设计了一个Blockbench插件用于制作模型包，访问下方链接学习如何安装此插件。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Open Link
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 打开链接

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Download Custom Model
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 下载自定义模型

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: You can find the model pack download button at the bottom of the maid GUI.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 你可以在女仆GUI下找到模型包下载按钮。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Click it to open the download GUI & choose to download the model packs that you like.$(br2)The model packs are all made by other players. If you also want to publish your custom model pack, you can click the button below to join our Discord group and submit your model pack.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 点击即可打开下载界面，选择并下载你喜欢的模型包。$(br2)这些模型包全部由玩家制作。如果你也想发布自己的模型包，你可以点击下方链接加入我们的Discord群组来提交你的模型包。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Discord Link
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: Discord链接

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Vanilla Changes
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 原版修改

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: We modified the slime model to the yukkuri.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 我们把史莱姆模型修改成了油库里。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: We also changed the textures of Experience Orbs, Bottle 'O Enchanting, and Totem of Undying. $(br2)These can all be turned off in the configuration file.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 我们还修改了经验球、附魔之瓶和不死图腾的纹理。$(br2)这些都可以在配置文件中关闭。

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Favorability
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 好感度

patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.en: Higher favorability will increase the maid's health and attack.$(br2)improving maid favorability:$(li)When the maid is in idle schedule, she will play with the keyboard, computer, bookshelf or gomoku.$(li)Maid sleeping.$(br2)Reducing maid favorability:$(li)Death of the maid.
patchouli.touhou_little_maid.book.entrie.zh: 好感度能够增加女仆的生命值和攻击力。$(br2)提升女仆好感度：$(li)女仆在空闲日程，玩耍电子琴、电脑、书架和五子棋。$(li)女仆睡觉。$(br2)减少女仆好感度：$(li)女仆死亡。
